analysis: Both units are base-side text of CHANGELOG.md, lines 4836-5275, which is historical release notes for v0.9.18 and earlier. The PR's only change in this file is documentation: a new v0.10.13 candidate heading and a highlights section, with the patch hunk at head lines 11-45. The patch excerpt is truncated and the head text is not supplied, so I could not see the full new text. The visible new text describes a Gemma 4 loop-exit-thinking behavior (#2040) and a pair-join "Stopped" display fix (#2042). It also states that mlx, mlx-swift and the toolchain are unchanged. These are descriptions of changes in other files, not code in this file. No code, configuration, trust-boundary or authorization behavior changes in CHANGELOG.md. Those other changes are possibly relevant to TB-007 (inference engine), T-010 (cancellation propagation) and TB-002. The 'loop guard closes thought and answers' behavior and the 'stop ends the leading Mac's start at once, also during download or load' behavior fall outside the supplied evidence. Nothing in the supplied evidence shows a security regression. The base text I reviewed mentions encrypted SSD cache behavior (T-041), but the PR does not alter it. The code implementing the new features was not supplied here, so the next pass should examine it: DARKBLOOM_LOOP_EXIT_THINKING, the reasoning token budget, the cluster pair stop semantics, and the unsupported-looking claim that libs are unchanged. Changelog claims are not proof of the code's behavior.
